## Rationale

`ci-workflow` executes after `wheel-contents` merges into `main`. That phase moves test dependencies into a `dev` dependency-group, declares project dependencies, and rewrites `scripts/test.sh` to `uv run pytest`. CI then uses `uv sync --locked --group dev` and `uv run pytest` and needs no later rewrite. The ruff autofix also lands after the in-flight phases, which lowers merge conflicts. The user chose this order.

## Counter-argument

Writing CI against `main` today (`uv run --no-project --with pytest ...`) starts the effort now and gives a signal sooner. The workflow then changes twice: once when `wheel-contents` lands, and again for any dependency change.

payload.alternatives: write CI against main today with --no-project --with
